instructions:
1. Sit on a bench with back support. Hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, palms facing you, elbows in front of your torso.
2. Press the dumbbells up and rotate your palms to face forward as you lift.
3. Extend your arms fully overhead.
4. Lower the dumbbells slowly, rotating your palms back toward you to return to the start.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Rotate the wrists smoothly through the whole press, not just at the top.
2. Exhale as you press up, inhale as you lower.
3. Keep your back against the pad to avoid arching.
4. Pick a weight that lets you control the rotation.

instructions:
1. Kneel on the platform pad of an assisted chin-up machine. Grasp the handles with a reverse grip, palms facing you, shoulder-width apart.
2. Pull your body up until your chin passes the bar.
3. Squeeze your back at the top.
4. Lower your body slowly until your arms are fully extended.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Drive your elbows down and back, not out to the sides.
2. Set the assistance so you can control both the lift and the descent.
3. Exhale as you pull up, inhale as you lower.
4. Avoid swinging or using momentum.

instructions:

2. Pull your body up until your chin passes the bar.
3. Squeeze your back at the top.
4. Lower your body slowly until your arms are fully extended.
5. Repeat.

2. Set the assistance so you can control both the lift and the descent.
3. Exhale as you pull up, inhale as you lower.
4. Avoid swinging or using momentum.
